description: Department of Public Enterprises - Remove the Two Members from the Board of Directors of the National Lotteries Board with Effect from the Date of Publication of this Order
categorisation: This gazette content names specific individuals (Mr. Dapana Durage Jayasiri and Mr. Randeniya Dewage Asanka Dayanath Jayarathne) and announces their removal from the Board of Directors of the National Lotteries Board. It includes the minister's name (Ranil Wickremesinghe) but only mentions his title ("Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies") without detailing his portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses solely on personnel changes without describing government structure or detailed portfolio assignments, making it a People Gazette.
